_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_horde_35-40b is written in the next phase. This part ends at the Booty Bay dock (boat to Ratchet, The Barrens), so 35-40b should start at Ratchet in The Barrens.

W_XP_RANGE: this is part a (about 35 to 37 of the 35-40 band). Quest XP is 78,225, 21% of the full 381,300 budget. The rest of the band is in 35-40b. What is left in the pack for this part is mostly Kalimdor turn-ins (1116, 1117, 1261, 1394, 1183), instanced or dungeon chains, class-only quests, and quests whose mobs are 40 or higher (see dropped[]).
Exit level 37 is an estimate. Quest XP alone reaches about 36.2 on the validator curve; kill XP is not counted, so about 37 is the expected in-game level at Booty Bay. Confirm before writing 35-40b.

The validator's expected-level curve spreads the whole 35-40 band over this route, so its W_MOB_LEVEL and trainer-gap numbers are stretched. Mob levels were checked by hand against 35-37. Quest 600 (crystals from lv 40-42 mobs) was dropped for that reason. 698, 598, 576, 587 and 209 are at most 2-3 levels above the expected level and are kept.

W_TRAINER_GAP: the trainer visits in this part are Stonard (about 35.5: hunter, shaman, warlock, warrior), Undercity (about 36: paladin, priest, warrior, mage, warlock), Grom'gol (hunter, about 36.5) and Booty Bay (rogue, about 37). The 38 and 40 visits belong to 35-40b. Thunder Bluff has paladin, priest, mage, druid, shaman, hunter and warrior trainers and is the natural 38 stop from the Barrens. No druid trainer is on this path (Thunder Bluff or Camp Mojache next); no rogue trainer is on the Undercity side of this part.

Hunter-only pet mastery (188, 192, 193) is class-limited with classes HUNTER; class XP is not counted. Elite chains are routed as optional-elite steps with revisitAt (193, 518, 519, 628, 640, 643, 644, 652, 673, 679, 680). Their dependants are either kept as optional (641) or dropped (645, 646, 688, 670).

Transport not verified in game: Stonard to Hammerfall, Hammerfall to Tarren Mill, Tarren Mill to Undercity and Undercity to Brill are walks. The Brill zeppelin to Grom'gol and the Booty Bay boat to Ratchet are from travel.json (verified). Hearth binds: Stonard, Hammerfall, Tarren Mill, Undercity, Booty Bay.

Handoffs to 35-40b and the main session: 1186 (in the part b pack) needs 1183, which is dropped here (Pozzik in the Shimmering Flats). 692 needs 687 and 1108 needs 1106, both in the part b pack. 1116 and 1117 (Kravel, Shimmering Flats) are dropped here and are not in the part b pack.

Unroutable (drop with unroutable true, reason in dropped[]): 1048 (instanced Scarlet Monastery bosses), 1113 (1109 has no DB source), 1713 (needs 1712, blocked by 1791), 6521 (6522 has no position), 6983 (6963 is level 60), 97985 (Stormheart in Thousand Needles). Quest 628 is kept as an optional-elite revisit at 40.
